volcano.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A single magnificent towering active stratovolcano model, full mountain visible, isolated on plain white. This is the hero environment asset for a high-quality stylized dark fantasy platform game. Monumental intimidating sense of scale: a tall powerful mountain with steep sweeping flanks and an asymmetrical sharp shattered crown, its foot approximately twice as wide as its height. A large open summit crater with molten scarlet magma. Exactly THREE clearly separated, very bold continuous rivers of brilliant saturated RED lava spill over large broken notches at the crater and run all the way down the mountain to its base. The main lava river is broad and unmistakable on the front face, meandering organically through a deep gorge and dividing once near the bottom; two secondary rivers flow down the other visible flanks. These lava rivers have smoothly flowing, brilliantly hot red interiors and thin orange-yellow center highlights, bordered by thick cool black lava crust. Strong graphic readability even as a small silhouette. Large solid dark navy-charcoal basalt masses separate the three rivers, with jagged vertical rock ribs and deep erosion gullies. Heroic dramatic angular shape language, hand-sculpted natural rock form with carefully painted chunky planes and a little surface detail. The texture is bold and designed, not noisy. NOT stacked circular platforms, NOT horizontal terraces, NOT a wedding-cake shape, NOT a pile of small pebbles. Not hundreds of thin red cracks: three wide uninterrupted spectacular lava channels dominate the design. Elevated front three-quarter view just high enough to see inside the open crater, showing the complete wide base and tall peak. Neutral studio backdrop, strongly readable geometry with cool top light and warm lava bounce, no landscape, no sky, no smoke, no clouds, no people, no structures, no text. A single substantial cohesive mountain, impressive enough to be the central landmark of an entire game level.

magma.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable ground texture for a polished stylized volcanic platform game. Orthographic straight-down material swatch filling the entire square: dark charcoal basalt crust floating on flowing vivid deep red magma, irregular broken crust plates of many sizes with rugged painted gray-black surfaces and branching broad organic glowing red fissures between them, very small orange-hot highlights only in the hottest centers. Elegant organic painterly flow and geological fractures, cohesive medium-scale detail, high quality hand-painted adventure-game surface texture with readable large dark landmasses and glowing molten seams. Red glow should be saturated scarlet and vermilion, not predominantly yellow or orange. Roughly 70% dark crust and 30% red molten channels. Uniform light with no cast shadows, no perspective, no gradient, no vignette, no border, no text, no white background, no volcano or landscape silhouette. Tile seamlessly on every edge; pattern continues beyond all edges.
